item.title: Super Bowl Road Closures and Traffic: Check if Your Route Is Affected This Week
item.description: Just because you’re not attending the Super Bowl in person doesn’t mean you’ll escape the impending traffic impacts and road closures.

item.title: San José Mayor Matt Mahan Announces Run for California Governor
item.description: Mahan jumped into the crowded race on Thursday, vowing to “fight for our values while also fixing our problems.”

item.title: California Lawmakers Want to Raise Taxes on For-Profit Immigrant Detention Operators
item.description: A new bill would impose a 50% tax on the detention contract revenues of companies that run immigration jails for the federal government, and reinvest those funds back into immigrant communities.

item.title: Financial Crisis Forces SF’s Mission Cultural Center for Latino Arts to Close
item.description: After months of financial strain, staff departures and scaled-back programming, the nearly 50-year-old nonprofit exhausted its operating funds, shuttering its Mission District building and leaving its future uncertain.

item.title: Still Unclear What’s Behind California’s Declining Crime Rate
item.description: This is part of a nationwide trend, as among 35 major cities, homicides dropped by 21% between 2024 and 2025.

item.title: Growing Wave of Silicon Valley Workers Condemns ICE as C-Suites Split Over Fear of Trump
item.description: Many more progressive rank-and-file tech workers stopped speaking out after the 2024 election as executives cozied up to Trump. For some, the recent killings in Minneapolis by federal agents mark a turning point.

item.title: California Demands Oakland Schools Make Sweeping Changes Over Antisemitism Complaints
item.description: Education officials said a district investigation didn’t go far enough to address concerns of Jewish and Israeli students. Critics warned of consequences for free speech.

item.title: California City’s Mayor is Torn Over New ICE Detention Center
item.description: Mayor Marquette Hawkins has mixed feelings on the ICE detention center that opened in his town last summer.

item.title: Cops Have to Treat Marijuana in Your Car Differently After New California Supreme Court Ruling
item.description: In a ruling handed down Thursday, the high court ruled that police must find marijuana in a condition that’s ready to be smoked if they are going to charge a driver with an open container violation.

item.title: Fremont Ready to Wave Goodbye to Tesla Models S and X, Welcome Its New Robot Overlords
item.description: East Bay officials are reacting to the news that Tesla will stop producing its Model S and X vehicles at its Fremont factory and switch to building Optimus humanoid robots by year’s end.
